results.title: GGC's MaryLove Edwards, Suryanshi Suryanshi reach ITA South Regional finals
Padres will have home-field advantage in wild-card rematch with Cubs
results.description: SAN DIEGO (AP) — The San Diego Padres have earned a wild-card rematch with the Chicago Cubs, and this time it will be at home in packed and raucous Petco Park. Manny Machado and the Padres beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 10-7 on Saturday to wrap up the No. 4 seed in the National League playoffs. [...]
